label: Emergency booking
blurb: A chipped tooth at 8am. Casey finds a same-day slot and checks the insurance.
outcome: Booked with Dr. Alvarez at 2:40pm · written to Dentrix · SMS sent

cues.text: Good morning, Lakeview Dental. This is Casey, the practice assistant. How can I help you today?
Hi. I chipped a tooth last night and it’s pretty sore. Is there any chance someone could see me today?
Oh, I’m sorry, that sounds painful. Let me check today’s emergency slots for you. I have an opening with Doctor Alvarez at two forty this afternoon. Would that work?
Yes, please. And do you take Delta Dental?
We do. I’ll take your member ID to check your benefits, and I’ll text you a confirmation with directions before we hang up.

label: Prescription refill
blurb: Casey reads the chart, confirms the pharmacy, and routes it to the provider.
outcome: Refill request routed to Dr. Mehta · telephone encounter written to chart

cues.text: Thanks for calling Lakeview Primary Care. This is Casey, the practice assistant. How can I help?
Hi, I need a refill on my blood pressure medication. I’m nearly out.
Of course. I can see the lisinopril ten milligram on your chart, last filled in April at the Walgreens on Fifth Street. Shall I send the request to Doctor Mehta at that same pharmacy?
Yes, that’s the one. How long will that take?
Doctor Mehta reviews refill requests twice a day, so you should hear from the pharmacy by this evening. I’m adding this to your chart now, and I’ll text you the moment it’s approved.

label: Escalation to a human
blurb: After hours, a caller wants a person. Casey stops and transfers immediately.
outcome: Transferred to the on-call dentist in 6 seconds · no triage attempted

cues.text: You’ve reached Lakeview Dental after hours. This is Casey, the practice assistant. I can book appointments or take a message. What do you need?
Honestly, I’d rather just speak to a person. My son fell and his front tooth is bleeding.
That needs a person right now. I’m connecting you to the on-call dentist this second. Please stay on the line, you’ll hear ringing in just a moment.
